findings.title: CI fix artifacts are uncommitted on remote branch
findings.claim: The Makefile hook, ensure-testapp-android-platform.sh script, and gradle.properties change exist only locally; origin/MOB-25129/upgrade-messaging-test-app still runs bare gradlew assemble-app and will fail CI.
findings.why_it_matters: CI calls make assemble-app from the reusable workflow; without the committed script/Makefile change, the platform-37 failure persists despite the testapp SDK bump.
findings.suggested_action: git add and push scripts/ensure-testapp-android-platform.sh, Makefile, and code/gradle.properties (or drop gradle.properties change if unnecessary).
caveats: Verified against local git state vs origin/MOB-25129/upgrade-messaging-test-app; did not re-run CI.
findings.challenge: User may intend to commit these files before merge; finding applies to current remote branch state only.

findings.title: set -e aborts before android-37.0 fallback when sdkmanager fails
findings.claim: With set -euo pipefail, a failing sdkmanager install at line 66 exits the script before the android-37.0 copy/link fallback at lines 68-71, even when ubuntu-24.04 runners already have platforms/android-37.0.
findings.why_it_matters: GHA ubuntu-24.04 images can preinstall API 37 as android-37.0 only while AGP 8.2 looks for android-37; the fallback is the intended bridge but is unreachable if sdkmanager returns non-zero.
findings.suggested_action: Wrap sdkmanager install in a non-fatal branch, pass --sdk_root explicitly, then symlink android-37.0 to android-37 when the target path is still missing.
caveats: Did not execute sdkmanager failure path on a GHA runner; inferred from bash set -e semantics and public runner-image behavior.
findings.challenge: If sdkmanager platforms;android-37 always succeeds on CI when android-37.0 is present, the fallback path is never needed and this is moot.

findings.title: cp -R duplicates platform SDK instead of symlinking
findings.claim: The android-37.0 to android-37 fallback uses cp -R, duplicating a large SDK tree on each cold CI run where only android-37.0 exists.
findings.why_it_matters: Adds disk and time on every build-app job that hits the fallback path; symlink is sufficient for AGP path resolution.
caveats: Symlink behavior not validated on GHA in this review.
findings.challenge: Some tooling may resolve symlinks differently; AGP platform lookup generally accepts symlinks.

findings.title: Makefile requires executable bit on shell script
findings.claim: Makefile invokes @./scripts/ensure-testapp-android-platform.sh which fails with Permission denied if the script is not committed with mode +x.
findings.why_it_matters: CI build-app job would fail before Gradle with a non-obvious permission error.
caveats: Local file currently has +x; git mode after add not verified in CI.
findings.challenge: If commit explicitly sets 100755, direct invocation works.

findings.title: suppressUnsupportedCompileSdk is orthogonal to platform-missing failure
findings.claim: android.suppressUnsupportedCompileSdk=37 in code/gradle.properties suppresses AGP warnings but does not install or alias platforms/android-37; it applies project-wide though only testapp uses SDK 37.
findings.why_it_matters: Adds scope beyond the minimal CI fix; may hide genuine AGP/SDK 37 compatibility warnings for all modules under code/.
findings.suggested_action: Remove unless CI logs show a separate warning-as-error; if needed, scope to code/testapp/gradle.properties.
caveats: Did not reproduce AGP warning output locally for this property.
findings.challenge: Project may treat AGP warnings as errors in CI, making this property required.

findings.title: License acceptance errors are masked
findings.claim: yes | sdkmanager --licenses >/dev/null 2>&1 || true discards license failures and stderr, deferring diagnosis to a later opaque sdkmanager install failure.
findings.why_it_matters: Reduces diagnosability when a fresh runner or sdkmanager update requires new license acceptance.
findings.suggested_action: Remove || true and redirect suppression, or omit the step on GHA where licenses are pre-accepted.
findings.challenge: Non-zero exit from --licenses on some environments may be benign noise.

findings.title: Idempotent early return skips corrupt android-37 directory
findings.claim: The script returns immediately when platforms/android-37 exists as a directory without validating android.jar or source.properties, so a corrupt partial install is never repaired.
findings.why_it_matters: Rare CI flake after interrupted copy could cause persistent opaque Gradle platform errors until the workspace is cleaned.
findings.suggested_action: Validate platform contents before early return; remove and relink if invalid.
caveats: No observed corrupt-directory failure in this repo.
findings.challenge: Fresh CI runners are ephemeral, making corrupt-state persistence unlikely.

areas_not_assessed: End-to-end CI run on ubuntu-24.04 after committing the fix
Whether sdkmanager platforms;android-37 always succeeds when android-37.0 is preinstalled on current GHA images
Whether AGP emits warning-as-error requiring suppressUnsupportedCompileSdk
